question: i got an incomplete, when do i have to finish the work
answer: Before the last day of scheduled classes of the next long semester you enroll in, unless your dean (with the instructor's consent) grants an extension. If you don't finish in time, or you register for the course again, the Registrar changes the I to an F.

question: what grade do i need to get an S if i take a class s/u, and does it hurt my gpa
answer: An S is given only for a C or above, and S hours don't count in your GPA. A D or F becomes a U, which earns no grade points and its hours do count in your GPA.

question: how many times am i allowed to retake the same class
answer: An undergraduate can attempt a course at most three times, unless both your dean and the department offering the course approve more.

question: if i retake a class i already got a B in do the new grade points count
answer: No. If you already earned a B or better in the course at Texas A&M, you get no grade points for repeating it, unless the catalog says the course can be repeated for credit.

question: can i still withdraw from all my classes after q drop day
answer: Not on your own: you can't start a withdrawal after the Q-drop deadline, though your dean may ask the Registrar to withdraw you after it in certain circumstances. Withdrawals start online in Howdy and go to your dean for approval, and you can't withdraw during finals.

question: if i withdraw from the semester will it show on my transcript
answer: It depends on timing. Withdraw on or before the official census date and the term leaves no academic record on your transcript; withdraw after it and you get a W in every course still in progress.

question: can i ride my skateboard inside buildings or on the steps
answer: No. Rollerblades, scooters, skateboards and other micro mobility can't be used in campus buildings or on benches, steps or walls under any circumstances.

question: can i bring my dog to class
answer: No. Animals aren't allowed in university buildings except where authorized; service animals are exempt. Emotional support animals need Disability Resources approval and are only allowed in residence halls, not other buildings.

question: can i just forward my tamu email to my gmail
answer: Yes, you can set it to forward automatically, but the university isn't responsible for mail once it leaves your TAMU mailbox, and you're still responsible for checking your official TAMU email often (the university recommends at least once a day).
